rationale: The agent properly verified identity using the user’s full name and zip code, matched to a single account. It listed recent orders using read-only tools and acted only on the authenticated user’s orders. Before each change (address update on #W4219264, watch variant change, and air purifier modification on #W6729841), the agent clearly stated the exact change and obtained explicit user confirmation. All writes were performed on pending orders, which are eligible for modification. The agent checked product availability and pricing, executed the modifications with correct item IDs, and the resulting refunds/charges aligned with tool outputs. Final summaries reflected the actual changes. No unauthorized disclosures or actions were taken. A minor note is the unverified statement about item modifications being limited to once per order, but it did not affect the correct completion of the user’s requests.
